changeSet.author: techdocs
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE unique_equipment ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, norm_key VARCHAR(900) NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- наимен.|модель|производитель (нормализ.) name VARCHAR(1000), model VARCHAR(500), manufacturer VARCHAR(500), passport_filename VARCHAR(500), passport_storage_path VARCHAR(1000), passport_status VARCHAR(32), -- UPLOADED/PROCESSING/READY/ERROR passport_error TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );

changeSet.author: techdocs
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE planned_works ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique_equipment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES unique_equipment(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, position INT, work_type VARCHAR(200), -- осмотр / ТО / контроль функционирования … name TEXT NOT NULL, work_composition TEXT, periodicity VARCHAR(200), periodicity_per_year NUMERIC(6,2), source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MANUAL' -- PASSPORT / MANUAL ); CREATE INDEX idx_planned_works_equipment ON planned_works(unique_equipment_id);
